nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The hallway buzzes with students rushing between classes as you and Aiko step out of the lecture room.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: You know… I don’t usually ask people to walk with me. Feel honored.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh? Am I supposed to feel special?

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: Obviously. My presence increases your social value by, like… three tiers at least.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: Um, excuse me? I’ll have you know there are people who would line up just to walk with me.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She leans in slightly, waiting for your response.

choices.text: Then I better stay close before someone steals you.
…Did nobody else see what I just saw??????

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Then I better stay close before someone steals you.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: W-What?! No one is stealing me! Don’t even joke about that!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I mean… I like walking with you too.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: Good. Then keep walking with me.

nodes.speaker: crazy
nodes.text: Aiko steps a little closer. The hallway noise fades beneath the warmth between you.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The lights are out.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh great.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: This is like one of those horror movies.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Except I'm in it. Hahahahahahahahahahaha.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: This isn't funny anymore Aiko.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uhhhhh Aiko?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well that was out of the ordinary....

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Aiko what's with you—

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: ....What the hell????
